column1: 21284§unravel§ʌnˈrævl§New research is now unravelling the ways in which bacteria aid digestion, regulate our immune systems, eliminate toxins, produce vitamins, affect our behaviour and even combat obesity.§如今新的研究**解释**了细菌是如何帮助消化、调节我们的免疫系统、排除毒素、产生维生素、影响我们的行为，甚至对抗肥胖的。§
21285§texture§ˈtekstʃə(r)§This kind of meat has a similar taste and texture to beef.§这种肉的味道和**口感**与牛肉类似。§
21286§assumption§əˈsʌmpʃn§The assumption has been shown to be incorrect by recent research.§最近的研究证明这一**假设**不正确。§
21287§dissatisfied§dɪsˈsætɪsfaɪd§They were dissatisfied with the treatment of animals at the London Zoo.§他们对伦敦动物园对待动物的方式表示**不满**。§
21288§simultaneous§ˌsɪmlˈteɪniəs§Any ceasefire would be simultaneous with the withdrawal of troops.§任何一次的停火都是与撤军**同时发生**的。§
21289§sundial§ˈsʌndaɪəl§Moonlight was frosting the dew, and an old sundial threw a long shadow.§月光把露水照得雪白，一座旧**日晷**投出一道长长的影子。§
21290§toxic§ˈtɒksɪk§Toxic chemicals were spilled from the factory into the river.§**有毒**的化学物从工厂排放到河里。§
21291§utilise§ˈjuːtəlaɪz§I guess the two main things to remember are to identify individual talent and then to utilise it.§我想需要记住的两个主要内容是确认个人天赋，然后再加以**利用**。§

21292§conformity§kənˈfɔːməti§One of the most important tasks of managers is to consider the needs of the individual on one hand and group cooperation and conformity on the other.§管理者最重要的任务之一是在考虑个人需求的同时还要兼顾团队的合作和**一致性**。§
21293§overrate§ˌəʊvəˈreɪt§Do you think that team player is overrated?§你认为那个队员被**高估**了吗？§
21294§dormant§ˈdɔːmənt§Mount St. Helens lay dormant for more than a century.§圣海伦斯火山**休眠**了一个多世纪。§
21295§displace§dɪsˈpleɪs§Each year rain and flooding displace millions of people and result in thousands of deaths.§每年，暴雨和洪水不仅使数百万人**背井离乡**，还会导致数千人丧生。§
21296§embrace§ɪmˈbreɪs§The students tearfully embraced each other on their last day of school.§在校的最后一天，学生们流着泪相互**拥抱**。§
21297§engrave§ɪnˈɡreɪv§Many researchers now think that these were pictures the wise men engraved of themselves.§现在许多研究者认为这些图像是一些聪明人按自己的样子**刻**上去的。§

21298§disrespectful§ˌdɪsrɪˈspektfl§Camping there on one's own may be disrespectful to the people of that culture, and certainly don't make fires, however romantic it may seem.§在那里单独露营可能会**冒犯**当地人，而且不管看起来多浪漫，一定不能生火。§
21299§invade§ɪnˈveɪd§Portugal was invaded by the French in 1807.§法国人在1807年**入侵**葡萄牙。§

21300§arcade§ɑːˈkeɪd§The most exciting place to visit is the new entertainment complex with a seven-screen cinema, bowling alley and video games arcade.§最值得参观的地方是新娱乐中心，里面有一家配有七个放映厅的电影院，还设有保龄球馆和电子**游戏厅**。§
21301§commentary§ˈkɒməntri§This bus company runs all its routes with a vivid commentary in English.§这家公交公司给其各条运营线路都配有生动的英文**解说**。§

21302§recreate§ˌriːkriˈeɪt§Since very few people will ever experience the Antarctic first-hand, the visitor's centre aims to recreate the atmosphere of the Antarctic.§由于很少有人能够亲自登上南极体验一把，因此游客中心旨在**再现**南极所特有的氛围。§改例句：Antarctic 作名词时前面要有 the，补 the
21303§mock§mɒk§There's a mock camp site where you can see inside an Antarctic tent and imagine yourself sleeping there.§这里有一个**模拟**的露营地，你可以看到里面有一个南极帐篷，想象一下自己睡在里面的情景。§
21304§territory§ˈterətri§We must realize that Antarctic territory belongs to everyone.§我们必须意识到南极的**领土**属于大家。§
21305§prohibit§prəˈhɪbɪt§Smoking is prohibited on most occasions.§大多数场合都**禁止**吸烟。§
21306§shipment§ˈʃɪpmənt§Finally the honey is poured into barrels for shipment.§最终蜂蜜被倒进桶里**运走**。§
21307§calendar§ˈkælɪndə(r)§Their five-year-old son is able to use the calendar to count how many days until his birthday.§他们五岁的儿子能用**日历**数出离他的生日还有多少天。§
21308§magic§ˈmædʒɪk§There's no real magic in the world.§这世界上没有真正的**魔法**。§
21309§slip§slɪp§Tom slipped on the ice and broke his leg.§汤姆在冰上**滑了一跤**，摔断了腿。§改译文：slip 是滑倒，改为「滑了一跤」
21310§shatter§ˈʃætə(r)§This event shattered all his previous ideas.§这件事**粉碎**了他以前所有的想法。§
21311§truce§truːs§A truce was declared to allow men to travel to the games in safety.§（政府）宣布了**休战协定**以使人们安全地去参加比赛。§
21312§discount§ˈdɪskaʊnt§For those of you who are up and about early in the morning, we are introducing a 50 percent "morning discount" this year.§今年，我们将为你们这些早起的人推出五折的“早间**折扣**”。§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
21313§tough§tʌf§Kangaroo meat is darker in colour and tougher than that of rabbit.§与兔肉相比，袋鼠肉颜色较深且肉质**较老**。§
21314§volunteer§ˌvɒlənˈtɪə(r)§Mary volunteered to work as a teacher in West Africa.§玛丽**自愿**去西非做一名教师。§
21315§eruption§ɪˈrʌpʃn§Geologists forecasted that an eruption of the volcano would take place before the end of the century.§地质学者预测，在本世纪结束之前该火山可能会**喷发**一次。§

21316§pension§ˈpenʃn§Even hourly employees receive benefits—such as pension contributions and medical insurance—that are not tied to the number of hours they work.§即使小时工也享受**养老金**和医疗保险等福利，但这些福利与他们工作的时长没有关系。§
21317§assignment§əˈsaɪnmənt§Have you been given any writing assignments yet?§有人给你布置写作**作业**了吗？§
21318§assign§əˈsaɪn§In that country, more land is assigned to car use than to housing.§那个国家的土地更多地被**指定**为停车之用，而不是建造住宅。§
21319§stainless§ˌsteɪnləs§It's made of stainless steel which is guaranteed for 50 years.§它由**不锈**钢制成，确保可以使用50年。§
21320§hallowed§ˈhæləʊd§In ancient Greece, sports games were held on hallowed ground near Mount Olympus every four years.§古希腊人每四年就要在奥林匹斯山附近的**圣**地举行运动会。§
21321§terminal§ˈtɜːmɪnl§There is an ink jet printer attached to each terminal.§每一个**终端**都连接有一台喷墨打印机。§
21322§climate§ˈklaɪmət§Farmed ostriches don't need African climates.§养殖鸵鸟并不要求一定有非洲的**气候**条件。§

21323§relevance§ˈreləvəns§I'm left-handed myself and I actually didn't see any relevance to my own life when I happened to start reading an article by a sports psychologist called Peter Matthews.§我自己就是左撇子，当我碰巧开始读运动心理学家彼得·马修斯所写的一篇文章时，我实际上并未意识到这与自己的生活有何**联系**。§

21324§reluctant§rɪˈlʌktənt§Although most trainers know how important handedness is, at present they are rather reluctant to make use of the insights scientists like Matthews can give.§尽管多数训练者知道用手习惯的重要性，但是目前他们仍然**不愿**采纳像马修斯这样的科学家的见解。§
21325§regularity§ˌregjuˈlærəti§Climate change is disrupting the regularity of the seasons.§气候的变化打破季节的**规律性**。§

21326§laterality§ˌlætəˈrælɪti§His team measured the hand, feet and eyes of 2,611 players and found that there were really three main types of laterality.§他的团队对2,611名演奏者的手脚和眼睛进行了测量，发现真的有三种主要的**偏侧性**类型。§改译文：laterality 是偏侧性，「侧重」是误译
21327§predominant§prɪˈdɒmɪnənt§Singers have a predominant role in this performance.§歌手在这场表演中担任**主要**角色。§

21328§trek§trek§We are organizing a ten-day holiday, from the sixteenth of November, with eight days actual walking, trekking in the Semira Mountains.§我们计划组织一个为期十天的假期旅行，从11月16日开始，其中包括在赛米拉山进行八天的实地步行和**跋涉**。§

21329§daunt§dɔːnt§Now, the Semira Mountains are among the highest in the world but you mustn't be too daunted, we will mainly be trekking in the foothills only, although there will be spectacular views even in the foothills.§如今，赛米拉山位于世界最高山脉之列，但你们不必太**胆怯**，我们基本上只在山麓徒步行走，但也能领略壮观的景色。§

21330§itinerary§aɪˈtɪnərəri§I will be distributing leaflets at the end where you can find out more information, but just for the moment I'll outline the itinerary, the main high points of the holiday.§最后，我会分发传单，你们可以从中了解更多的信息，但目前我要概述一下**旅行路线**，都是假期的热门景点。§

21331§acclimatise§əˈklaɪməˌtaɪz§After a couple of days to acclimatise yourself, you'll start the trek on day three walking through the enormous Katiba Forest which will take the whole of the day.§前两天让自己**适应环境**，第三天要开始徒步穿越巨大的卡蒂巴森林，这需要一整天的时间。§
21332§forthcoming§ˌfɔːθˈkʌmɪŋ§This is the list of forthcoming books.§这是**即将**出版的书籍目录。§
21333§structure§ˈstrʌktʃə(r)§The biologist is giving a lecture on cellular structures.§那位生物学家正在做一个有关细胞**结构**的讲座。§
21334§quantity§ˈkwɒntəti§This medicine will reduce the quantity of blood flowing through the body.§这种药会减少体内的血流**量**。§
21335§integral§ˈɪntɪgrəl§This kind of beetle has become an integral part of the successful management of dairy farms in Australia over the past few decades.§在过去的几十年里，这种甲虫已成为澳大利亚乳牛场成功管理所**必不可少**的一部分。§
21336§intensive§ɪnˈtensɪv§Intensive English classes are taught in four-week blocks throughout the year.§**强化**英语班全年授课，四周为一期。§
21337§acknowledge§əkˈnɒlɪdʒ§Plagiarism is taking other people's work without acknowledging it, that is, without saying where it comes from.§剽窃就是引用了人家的作品却不**承认**，即不注明出处。§
21338§liquor§ˈlɪkə(r)§David got hooked on hard liquor.§戴维喝**烈酒**成瘾。§
21339§presence§ˈprezns§Elliot discovered the presence of five rings encircling the equator of Uranus.§埃利奥特发现**存在**五个光环围绕着天王星赤道。§改译文：「有」太泛，presence 改为「存在」
21340§develop§dɪˈveləp§When a country develops its technology, the traditional skills and ways of life die out.§一个国家在**发展**技术的同时，会造成传统手工艺和原有生活方式的消亡。§
21341§blast§blɑːst§The granite was blasted into boulders no bigger than two metres in diameter.§花岗岩被**炸**成直径不超过两米的大石头。§
21342§greatly§ˈgreɪtli§The process of growing bananas was greatly reduced with modern growing methods.§现代种植技术**大大**缩短了香蕉的种植过程。§
21343§sporadically§spəˈrædɪkli§Rockets had been used sporadically for several hundred years.§在过去的几百年间，火箭被人们**偶尔**使用。§
21344§imitate§ˈɪmɪteɪt§Children like to imitate adults.§儿童喜欢**模仿**大人。§
21345§constitution§ˌkɒnstɪˈtjuːʃn§Many people are concerned that such an emphasis on humanity's genetic constitution may distort our sense of values.§许多人担心，对人类基因**组成**如此重视可能会歪曲我们的价值观。§
21346§advocate§ˈædvəkeɪt§Some architects advocated the use of masonry in the construction of skyscrapers.§一些建筑师**提倡**采用石工技术建造摩天大楼。§
21347§maintenance§ˈmeɪntənəns§The school pays for heating and the maintenance of the buildings.§学校负担这些大楼的取暖和**维修**费用。§
21348§spouse§spaʊs§How your child adapts to your divorce is largely dependent on how you and your spouse act.§你的孩子如何适应你的离婚主要取决于你和你**配偶**的行为举止。§
21349§expedition§ˌekspəˈdɪʃn§I talked to Charles Owen, the leader of the expedition group, about the trip.§我和**探险**队队长查尔斯·欧文谈了关于出行的事。§
21350§incendiary§ɪnˈsendiəri§In the early nineteenth century the British began to experiment with incendiary barrage rockets.§19世纪初，英国就开始试验**燃烧式**扫射火箭。§
21351§expansion§ɪkˈspænʃn§Even without further expansion the school could recruit around 2,000 students every year.§即使没有进一步的**扩建**，学校每年仍可招收2,000名学生。§
21352§encase§ɪnˈkeɪs§The resin oozed out of the tree and the spider or leaf became encased in it.§树脂从树里渗出来，把蜘蛛或树叶**包**在了里面。§
21353§invalid§ɪnˈvælɪd§The judge declared Tom's marriage invalid.§法官宣布汤姆的婚姻**无效**。§
21354§unbiased§ʌnˈbaɪəst§I wanted to get her unbiased comments on my article.§我想要的是她对我的文章给出**不偏不倚**的评论。§
